Big shout that pops up over an enemy ship the player destroys with a hit of at least twice the shields and hull it had left

en: [color=blue]Forward[/color], to the front, where the run ends.\n[color=purple]Back[/color], toward Fate, where it collects what it's owed.
_context: Body of the last gate's choice card: what each of the two jump directions means
Button on the last gate's card: jump forward to the front, the normal ending. Fits a medium button
Button on the last gate's card: turn back and dive toward the black hole, the secret fight. Fits a medium button
Who is speaking on the revelation screen after the last boss falls: the Rearguard's commander, as their ship dies

en: Four hundred years we held the line. You want to know what we were holding back?
_context: Revelation line 1 of 7: the dying Marshal begins to tell the game's secret

en: Nothing. There's a black hole ahead of us too. There always was.
_context: Revelation line 2 of 7

en: The fleet was never escaping. It's being herded.
_context: Revelation line 3 of 7

en: The Vanguard made a deal with it. The front lives. The Vanguard lives. The back of the fleet pays.
_context: Revelation line 4 of 7: the Vanguard is the leader at the front of the fleet

en: Every die the Tithe Collector took went into the hole. I counted them myself.
_context: Revelation line 5 of 7: the Rearguard's tax of dice was a sacrifice

en: The Vanguard gave its Marshals a drive that can outrun a horizon. In case. Take it.
_context: Revelation line 6 of 7: the player is given the drive needed for the secret fight

en: If you're the kind who goes looking for Fate, it will see you coming.
_context: Revelation line 7 of 7: a hint that the secret route opens for players who carve every face of Fate's Die

en: You've heard this before, haven't you? Then you know what's behind you.
_context: Short revelation, line 1 of 2, for a player who already learned the secret in an earlier run

en: Take the drive. Forward, or back. Your choice. It always was.
_context: Short revelation, line 2 of 2

en: You rolled off the table. The first thing in history that doesn't count.
